correctness.rationale: Assesses the corrected RESULT.md under /workspace/repairs/3/. The frozen Finding incorrectly says the product integrand is continuous at zero. For t>0 it behaves as t/(2π√λ); only the multiplier has a continuous extension to t. The corrected file specifies the integrable endpoint and clarifies that r=1 is on the unit circle. No formula, hypothesis or verification code changes. For the one-site unit-rate pulse, outward support growth has finite Poisson-dominated moments; the bond jump has drift (a−b)/(2W), telescoping over bonds, and second moment (a²−ab+b²)/(3W²). Thus X is a centered square-integrable martingale with variance derivative D=(2F_0−F_1)/3. Independently, track two energy labels with independent placements conditional on each bond split. Their separation law is p_0=F_0, p_k=2F_k for k≥1. Rates 0→1 and 1→0 are both 2/3 (same-bond split or reunion); 1→2 and both tail nearest-neighbor rates are 1. The forward equations reproduce the stated defect and tail coefficients. The decaying resolvent root yields D-hat=(1−b²)/(b(b²+2))=1/(2b)−3b/(2(b²+2)), b=1−r. At s=−λ+i0, Re b=λ/2, |b|²=λ and Im b=√(λ(4−λ))/2. Then |b²+2|²=3λ²−4λ+4, and −Im D-hat/π yields exactly the stated positive density. The physical branch |r|<1 off the cut has no poles; the O(s^−1/2) singularity at zero and the bounded upper endpoint contribute no atoms in the contour inversion. At t=0 the multiplier is zero; differentiating the compact-support representation gives strict increase and concavity and the generator yields D(0)=2/3 and D′(0)=−5/9. An independent bounded quadrature reproduced both spectral moment checks at numerical precision (replay: /workspace/branches/202609f9-72f6-462f-9b3a-0503c3f9f056/kmp_spectral_moments.py); this is not the inversion proof. Expanding b=√s−s/2+s^(3/2)/8+… gives D-hat=1/(2√s)+1/4−11√s/16+O(s); the density expansion and Watson's lemma give an integrable residual from the leading t^−1/2 derivative. Its integral is the transform limit 1/4 and its integrated tail gives −11/(16√(πt)). Rate two simply replaces t with 2t. Frozen support inspected, not executed.
